source.units: feet; x/y scene plan feet (ORIGIN_SC), heights relative to local class-2 ground unless stated

alignment.note: Lidar placed with the scene <-> UTM helpers, then shifted by -shift_applied_ft (NAD83(2011) vs the NAIP/WGS84 scene frame); values below are residuals after the shift. Positive deck-edge offset = lidar edge outside the plan deck-edge line. Pole offsets = centroid of tall returns minus the plan pole centre (coarse, +-4 ft: the clusters are mostly arm/luminaire returns; the deck edges are the main evidence).

pavement.note: median class-2 ground on modelled pavement within 60 ft of the bridge on Spring Cypress

bridge.note: s = distance along the SH 249 axis (north positive) from the deck centre line at Y = 0; heights relative to the Spring Cypress pavement reference. top = mainlane surface (densest upper layer), ground_under = median class-2 return more than 3 ft below the top (header banks / road under the deck), span_s_ft = 0.5-99.5 percentile of class-17 (bridge deck) returns along the axis. Cross-sections: [offset across the axis (east +), 20th-percentile surface].

trees.method: CHM = highest return - class-2 ground on a 0.5 m grid, grey-opened with a 1.5 m disc (removes poles, arms, wires), Gaussian sigma 0.5 m; tops = local maxima > 4 m, >= 2 m apart (min_distance 4 cells); crowns = watershed of the CHM, restricted to >= 50 % of the top height; radius = sqrt(area/pi); height = max opened CHM within 1 m of the top. Kept if crown radius >= 4 ft and >= 15 % of the returns above 6 ft in the crown are from multi-return pulses (foliage). Excluded: building footprints + 1.5 m, deck footprint + 10 ft. Tops over pavement/curb/sidewalk moved up to 6 ft onto roadside/island, else dropped.

as_built_check.note: Returns 8-26 ft above ground (pole, arm root, luminaire) within 6 ft of each pole centre. The flight is 2024, so the proposed poles are not expected. Existing poles are the control.
